text: Dow Inc. is a Delaware holding company for The Dow Chemical Company and its consolidated subsidiaries ('TDCC'), together with which it operates as 'Dow'. Its common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DOW.
short: The partner Dow is Dow Inc. (NYSE: DOW).
